tools.name: batch-call
tools.status: Powerful but heavy.
strengths: Strong input schema and explicit stop or continue semantics.
issues: Title and description are identical.
Most outputs are stringified JSON subreports instead of typed nested objects.
recommendedFixes: Return typed nested report objects.
Add short descriptions for onError and core output fields.

tools.name: databaseobject-delete
tools.status: Clear intent with minor schema friction.
issues: autoSave and refresh are strings with no descriptions or defaults.
recommendedFixes: Promote common flags to booleans with descriptions.

tools.name: databaseobject-move
tools.status: Readable action with minor flag ambiguity.
strengths: Move and reorder intent is obvious.
Output fields distinguish source and target parents.
issues: autoSave and refresh are strings with no descriptions.
recommendedFixes: Document or strongly type the common flags.

tools.name: databaseobject-rename
tools.status: Readable action with minor flag ambiguity.
strengths: newQName and updateMode are useful outputs.
issues: update, autoSave, and refresh lack descriptions.
recommendedFixes: Describe update behavior and common flags.

tools.name: databaseobject-schema
tools.status: Useful helper with a slightly overloaded surface.
strengths: Purpose and supported formats are clear.
Helpful bridge between requestables and SmartType wiring.
issues: internal is a string flag with no enum or detailed description.
response is overloaded across xml, json, and jsonschema cases.
recommendedFixes: Type internal as a boolean.
Use more explicit output field names for sample versus schema.

tools.name: databaseobject-search
tools.status: One of the clearest tools in the catalog.
strengths: Intent is obvious from the name and description.
Output shape is compact and understandable.
issues: matchCase and useRegExp are string flags without descriptions.
recommendedFixes: Type the search toggles more explicitly.

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-apply
tools.status: Canonical but still expert-oriented.
strengths: at and mode enums are strong guide rails.
issues: tree is intentionally open-ended and needs guide support.
Output relies heavily on stringified JSON report fields.
recommendedFixes: Return typed nested reports.
Add a short structural description for the tree payload.

tools.name: databaseobject-tree-get
tools.status: Canonical but not yet self-explanatory enough.
issues: Output uses ambiguous capitalized fields Tree and Forest.
No schema-level description explains the returned tree structure.
recommendedFixes: Rename Tree and Forest to explicit nested payload names.
Describe the returned canonical tree shape.

tools.name: log-view
tools.status: Rich input filtering with weak output ergonomics.
strengths: Input filters are broad and mostly documented.
issues: Output is mostly flat strings like lines and query.
No structured log entry array is exposed.
recommendedFixes: Expose a typed log entries array alongside the raw text view.

tools.name: marketplace-import
tools.status: Useful and mostly understandable.
strengths: Output distinguishes import and reference outcomes.
issues: A few response fields remain technical rather than user-oriented.
recommendedFixes: Add a short response summary field.

tools.name: marketplace-list
tools.status: Strong discovery tool.
strengths: Output already exposes useful status and suggestion fields.
issues: None blocking in Phase 0.
recommendedFixes: Keep response compact while adding guide hints later.

tools.name: mobile-builder-open
tools.status: Input side is clear, output side is opaque.
issues: Success output is hidden behind a generic result string.
Schema suggests an error wrapper instead of a typed success object.
recommendedFixes: Expose explicit success fields such as builderUrl, launchAction, and logs.

tools.name: palette-describe
tools.status: Best-in-class guide companion.
strengths: Output gives entry metadata, templates, and propertyHints.
issues: verbose is a string flag without a description.
recommendedFixes: Document verbose or replace it with a typed flag.

tools.name: palette-list
tools.status: Clear discovery tool with minor typing friction.
strengths: Output already points callers to palette-describe.
issues: includeBuiltIn, includeShared, and limit are strings rather than clearer types.
Input field descriptions are sparse.
recommendedFixes: Document or strongly type the discovery toggles.

tools.name: project-js-get
tools.status: Works, but reads like an internal helper.
strengths: Description is better than the title.
issues: Mechanical title.
filename has no description.
The output content field may be large without warning.
recommendedFixes: Rename the title to a user-facing sentence.
Describe filename and content behavior.

tools.name: project-js-set
tools.status: Works, but reads like an internal helper.
strengths: Description is better than the title.
issues: Mechanical title.
filename and content have no descriptions.
recommendedFixes: Rename the title to a user-facing sentence.
Describe filename and content expectations.

tools.name: project-list
tools.status: Good discovery starting point.
issues: filter and limit could still use descriptions.
recommendedFixes: Add short descriptions for the input filters.

tools.name: project-reload
tools.status: Simple and understandable.
issues: Could expose a short caution about discarding unsaved memory state in the input schema.
recommendedFixes: Add an input-level caution note in the description.

tools.name: project-save
tools.status: Simple and understandable.
issues: Could better explain the project resolution behavior when project is omitted.
recommendedFixes: Document the default project resolution behavior.

tools.name: rag-query
tools.status: Useful fallback with one awkward output field.
strengths: Description clearly explains when to use it.
issues: referencesArray is a string rather than a typed array.
recommendedFixes: Return references as a real array.

tools.name: requestable-execute
tools.status: Critical tool with the weakest self-documentation.
issues: Title and description are too vague.
Output result and error are effectively untyped.
The error field shape is surprising and not descriptive.
recommendedFixes: Replace the title and description with user-facing wording.
Expose a typed execution envelope with success, payload, and logs.
